verdict.rationale: Postman documents team workspaces where members can share, version, and collaborate on API work, with roles and permissions at the team, workspace, and element levels. It also offers real-time live sessions on requests. However, the evidence never explicitly says collections themselves are shared and kept automatically in sync across teammates within a workspace. missing for 10: explicit documentation that collections are shared within team workspaces, explicit documentation of automatic syncing of collection changes across members, independent or hands-on corroboration of synced collection sharing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share collections with my team in a synced shared workspace

citations.quote: Create internal workspaces, where team members can share, version, and discuss their work and collaborate on API projects.
Workspaces enable you to collaborate with teammates or anyone in the Postman community.
You can define the roles and permissions assigned to team members at the team, workspace, and element levels.
you can start a live session in an HTTP request to collaborate with your team in real time as you test, develop, and troubleshoot.
